title: The Schedule screen is split into a left work order sidebar and a main schedule grid
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in on a desktop browser (window at least 960px wide).
  2. Your role has Schedule: View and Work Orders: View.
custom_steps:
1. Open the Schedule page.
  2. Look at the two regions of the screen.
custom_expected:
1. The left panel is the work order sidebar: a mini calendar at the top and a work order list beneath it.
  2. The main area is the schedule grid showing technician rows and a toolbar above it.
